$comment: Files that must NOT be shipped in packaged builds (AppImage etc.). They are optional content packs downloaded on demand from the GitHub release 'packs-v1' (see docs/SPEC.md › Content packs, scripts/packs/build.mjs). When a packager is added, feed these globs to its exclude list — e.g. electron-builder: "files": ["**/*", ...excludes.map(g => '!' + g)] and keep them out of "extraResources".
